notes.title: Patch Notes 18.10.2022
notes.notes:
[b]New features[/b]

[i]General[/i]
• In the first levels of heroic life, five new visually coherent sets (without set bonuses) are unlocked in the Second Hand Shop.

[i]Workouts[/i]
• With the Fitness Sense you can now make your Workouts easier!
• With an activated Fitness Sense, you can instantly find the Fitness Exercises with the best coin, Experience Points, or Fitness Points rewards!
• While the Fitness Sense is active, the rewards for Fitness Exercises are tripled, while the costs are doubled.

[b]Maintenance[/b]

[i]General[/i]
• When randomizing the appearence of the character, now all available costumization options are available.
• It was possible that tutorial messages were displayed on the wrong game screen. This has been fixed.
• Heroic deeds now always disappear from the list, after the reward is claimed.
• It was possible that items from the inventory became invisible, if, for example, a surprise box was dragged onto the character when there was no free inventory space. This problem has been fixed.
• The casino button only displayed the first 2 numbers of available free games. This has been fixed.
• In the result of the player search in the ranking list, sometimes the wrong line was highlighted. This issue has been fixed.

Best regards,

Your Hero Zero Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25427933/b64e5ccf7efb35af0e81894fd7657a2145bd616c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 08.03.2022
notes.notes:
[b]New features[/b]
[i]General[/i]

• In the Ouufit feature you can now set a specific outfit for Hardmode Special Missions.

[i]Hideout[/i]
• New Levels have been added for the following Hideout Rooms:
• The Scout Center can now be levelled up to 30
• The Sports Bar can now be levelled up to 30
• The Private Fight Club can now be levelled up to 25
• The Gym can now be levelled up to 30

[b]Preview: Season Trilogies
[/b]

Today we want to give you a little preview for an extension of the Season Feature: the Season Trilogies! While the Seasons are running regularly, three consecutive Seasons will get a bigger Main Theme together. During the whole runtime of a Season Trilogy there will be fitting extra Specials, which can be different every time. We'll start with the Season Trilogy: Primeval Times, during which a primeval villain will make their rounds in Humphreydale, having extra cool loot in stock for you!

Yours,

Your Hero Zero Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25427933/d05075bc9315b1311d3207bbbcf7516496ccd4fc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 11.01.2022
notes.notes:
[b]Maintenance[/b]

[i]General[/i]
• The attack list in the opponent selection for team fights can now be sorted by Level, amount of members and honor.

[i]Preview[/i]
We hope you all had a heroic start into the new Year and are looking forward to a cool 2022 with you! We're starting the year off with good news for fans of Special Missions - as we announced last time, our developers and game designers are currently working on a new PvE feature. The new feature is developed for the Special Missions, in order to make these more exciting and rewarding, especially for highlevel players. The first sketches for some cool new items you'll be able to get there we already shared with you. This time we will give you a preview of some parts of the user interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25427933/c3deb78f797bce0e7b67c3caf5c6a12ffe6180a9.jpg[/img]

Your Hero Zero Team

notes.notes:

[b]General[/b]

• The Heroic Deed "Catch Them All!" has been expanded.

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes 🦸‍♂️ 2020-09-22
notes.notes:
[h2]New features[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]  In the confirmation dialogue, when attaching a modification, the tooltip now shows the target item.
[*]  Experiencepoint rewards in Hero Distress Calls and daily bonuses now scale with the character level.
[*]  Vouchers can now be filtered according to their type
[*]  The Multitasking feature has been expanded - you can now complete missions, take part in villain fights AND play in the Casino at the same time!
[*]  In the Workshop and the Hero Forge, now the items that are being generated are displayed.
[*]  The tutorial for the Hero Hideout has been adjustet to show clearer what needs to be done.
[*]  For the Champion League Set in the Secret Offer Shop there's now the fitting and cute Sidekick Ruffy available!
[*]  Vouchers now show the expiration day, on which they will be automatically redeemed on login.
[*]  In the preferences for team applications, the options "Hero Hideout: Minimum Expansion Level " and "Hero Hideout: Minimum Workshop Level" have been added.
[*]  Vouchers for Super Glue or Zeronite won't prompt a "Redeem now or later" dialogue anymore.
[*]  Coin rewards in the Casino have been upgraded.
[/list]
 

[h3]Maintenance[/h3]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]  The SMS payment method was not working as intended in the Secret Offer Shop. This issue has been resolved.
[*]  In the HTML5 version, the icons in the Exchange Room were sometimes reversed. This issue has been resolved.
[*]  In the HTML5 version, item and booster rewards from the Casino have not been displayed properly. This issue has been fixed.
[/list]
 

[b]Mobile[/b]
[list]
[*]  It was possible that the tooltip for a duel opponent showed the values of the previous opponent. This issue has been fixed.
[*]  It was possible that after refreshing workouts the rewards of the previous workouts were displayed. This issue has been fixed.
[*]  During a Villain HeroCon it was possible that the game crashed if there were no Villain times available. This issue has been fixed.
[/list]

Greetings
Your Hero Zero Team.

notes.title: Patch notes 2020-06-30
notes.notes:
The following new features were added today (2020-06-30):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]New features[/b]

General
• From now on, a new daily bonus can be achieved, which requires spending 100, 200 or 300 mission energy.
• Daily Bonuses, Seasons and Hero Distress Calls can now also give out Zeronite or Super Glue as rewards. The amount is dependent on the best production building in your Hero Hideout.


[b]Seasons[/b]
• During a Season you can now also be rewarded with Modifications for your items.
• The Season dialogue will now automatically pop up in the mission screen when there are still rewards to be collected after the Season ended.


[b]Maintenance[/b]
HTML5 Version
• It was possible that you could not start new conversations. This issue has been fixed.


[b]General[/b]
• In the Windows version, the hero selection did not work as intended. This issue has been fixed.
• It was possible that more Batteries than needed were used for actions. This issue had been fixed via hotfix.
• Several minor bugs have been fixed.


Greetings
Your Hero Zero Team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25427933/411c0264b574055ad37beb5809c6c900d1883e6a.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch notes 2020-06-02
notes.notes:
The following new features were added today (2020-06-02):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New features
PvP Tournament
• From now on, a cross-server PvP Tournament will take place every week!
• Compete with heroes from all over the world!
• Collect points participating in duel and league fights. In case of a draw, the amount of fights won decide.
• The best 10000 players receive experience points as reward.
• The first PvP Tournament starts directly with the update and runs until Wednesday 19:00 UTC
• The following PvP Tournaments will start every Wednesday 19:00 UTC and run until the following Wednesday 19:00 UTC.


Seasons
• Starting with the upcoming Season, the intervals in between reward steps will be scaled-down and the costs for unlocking them will be lowered. In return, the number of reward steps will be increased.
• Starting with the upcoming Season, Season Points will also be awarded for:
- the daily bonus for completing Hero Distress Calls
- weekly Hero Distress Calls
- daily Hero Distress Calls
- reaching all 3 workout goals during training


General
• On Android and iOS devices, the push notifications now inform you again about messages in private conversations, started events and team attacks/defences.
• The same notifications are now also supported in the browser
 

Maintenance
HTML5 Version
• Continuous text should now be displayed more clearly.
• It was possible that text, which was entered into private messages, was entered into the team chat instead. This issue has been fixed.
• Text could not be pasted. This issue has been fixed.

 
General
• It was possible, that the Donut Shop wasn't loaded correctly directly at game start.
• Several minor bugs have been fixed.

 

Greetings
Your Hero Zero Team.

notes.title: Patch notes 2020-05-05
notes.notes:
The following new features were added today (2020-05-05):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New features
Seasons
• In the Season dialog, a preview for the item and sidekick rewards is now displayed.
• Hew heroic deeds for the Season feature have been added.
• When looking at another player, his and your active season bonus will now be displayed.
• For players online during the start of a new Season, the new Season should now be activated without delay.

 

General
• The missile "In the Night Flapping Shadow-Casts of the Clumsy Criminal Hunter" which is obtainable through the heroism mission "CSI: Big Crumble" have been added to the missile item pattern collection.
• In the ranking list, you can now see how often you have attacked a player and how often you can still attack them.
• From the next "Hero of the Month" competition on, a new reward will be available.

 

Hero Hideout
• New levels for 9 hideout heroic deeds have been added.
• In the Hideout, a third Work Robot can now be rented after the second Work Robot has been purchased.
• An option has been added to the game options that allows the animations of the bots in the hideout to be deactivated.

 

Maintenance work
General
• The Enter and ESC keys now work correctly in many dialogs.
• Several minor bugs have been fixed.

 

Greetings
Your Hero Zero Team.

notes.title: Patch notes 2020-03-31
notes.notes:
The following new features were added today (2020-03-31):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New features
Seasons
• On Aptil 7th, 2020, we'll launch a brand new feature: Seasons!
• During a Season, you can collect Season Points when completing certain activities in game and unlock heroic rewards, for example, special item and weapon sets with powerful set bonuses, unique sidekicks, as well as equiment pieces for your heroic homes.
• During every Season, all players benefit from a special bonus effect. The more Season Points a player collects, the stronger the effect for that player.
• The first season is under the sign of the beetle and grants all players a season bonus on their basic intuition in all battles against other players.

 

General
• In the messaging system, there's now an option to ignore messages from all players not in your friendlist or team.
• The User Interface can now be turned off for cool screenshots.
• Items, which are part of an Outfit, are now highlighted with an icon.

 

Maintenance work
General
• Several minor bugs have been fixed.

 

Greetings
Your Hero Zero Team.

notes.title: Patch notes 2020-03-10
notes.notes:
The following new features were added today (2020-03-10):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New features
General
• A new item set is available in the Secret Offer Shop, alongside a fitting new sidekick!
• Grab yourself an extra stylish outfit, together with the coolest sidekick of Humphreydale!
• The duel and league tooltip now displays if an opponent has missiles equipped or not.
• Leaders and advisors of a team now have access to advisor's notes, which only they can see and edit.
• The difficulty of villains after HeroCons is now not affected anymore by villains that show up during HeroCons.

 

Sidekicks
• New Sidekicks can now be displayed as animated in the HTML5 version.
• Over the next weeks and months, already existing sidekicks will also be converted using the new method for the animations.

 

Maintenance work
General
• Several minor bugs have been fixed.

 

Greetings
Your Hero Zero Team.

notes.title: Patch notes 2020-02-11
notes.notes:
The following new features were added today (2020-02-11):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New features
General
• Members of your own team are no longer displayed in the duel list.
• Three new HeroCons have been added to the HeroCon rotation.
• The lead time for Gang Fights has been increased to 10 hours. This was necessary in order to prevent exploits.

 

Sidekicks
• If you fought your way up into the Gold League, you can now buy a new kuddly Sidekick.
• Three new adorable Sidekicks await you, which are sometimes temporarily available for purchase in the Donut Shop after a Level-Up.
• When you release a Sidekick, you now get Coins as a reward. A respective Heroic Deed has been added as well.

 

Hero Hideout
• In the Workshop, Sidekick Collars can now be produced as well.
• The amount of Zeronite and Super Glue required for the Hero Forge has been decreased.

 

Heroic Deeds
• The heroic deed Warm Feud Gloves has been expanded by 10 new levels.
• The heroic deed Completely Off the Mark! has been expanded by 10 new levels.
• The heroic deed Game, Set and Match has been expanded by 10 new levels.
• The heroic deed Over 3,000!? has been expanded by 10 new levels.
• The heroic deed Over Law and Order has been expanded by 10 new levels.
• The heroic deed HeroCon Veteran has been expanded by 10 new levels.

 


Maintenance work
General
• In the HTML5 version the tooltip is now no longer covered if you click on a link in a chat while the chat is displayed at the position of the friend list.
• After changing servers it was possible that the status for the daily Login bonus as well as for object collection tasks was displayed for the previous character. This issue has been fixed.
• The button for the Casino was permanently highlighted, even if no free game was available. This issue has been fixed.
• Several minor bugs have been fixed.

 

Greetings
Your Hero Zero Team.

notes.title: Patch notes 2020-01-14
notes.notes:
The following new features were added today (2020-01-14):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New features
General
• The bars for your skills are now more colourful! From now on, the Skillbars shine in 10 new colours.

 

Heroic Hideout
• A new Hideout room is now available: The Hero Forge
• The Hero Forge requires one construction site and will be unlocked once the Hideout Base has been upgraded to at least level 3.
• In the Hero Forge, you can produce items in exchange for Coins, Super Glue or Zeronite.
• Each time you upgrade the Hero Forge, additional possible items can be produced. you can look forward to Missiles, Sidekicks, One-time Modification Sockets, Collars with modification slots and more!
• Starting at expansion level 3, the production of parts of an exclusive item set is possible, which is only obtainable in the Hero Forge.
• The Hero Forge can be upgraded up to Expansion Level 10.

 

Maintenance work
General
• If a message is received,the proper sound will now be played again.
• Some adjustments and bugfixes have been implemented in the HTML version of the game. We're looking forward to your further feedback!
• Several minor bugs have been fixed.

 

Greetings
Your Hero Zero Team.

notes.title: Patch notes 2019-12-10
notes.notes:
The following new features were added today (2019-12-10):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New features
HTML Version
• The HTML version has been considerably updated!
• Major bug fixes, as well as optimizations have been implemented. Many problems in the mobile version have been fixed as well.
• We are looking forward to hear your further feedback and invite you to continue to test the new version thoroughly. This is especially important, since starting December 2020, the current Flash version will not be supported anymore in most browsers.

 

General
• Memorialize your heroism! If you finish a HeroCon in the Top 5 ranks, you now win a respective cool prize cup as a piece of equipment that you can place in frnt of your heroic home!
• Adrenalin will now be refilled each day at midnight.
• The sidekick list is now easier scrollable.
• While a mission is in progress, the type of mission is now displayed.
• It is not possible anymore to delete a team if a team fight is pending and either of the teams are in possesion of trophies. This applies to attacks as well as defenses. This measure was necessary in order to prevent some exploits.

 

Heroic Hideout
• The maximum levels of many rooms have been increased!
• The following rooms can now be upgraded by 25 additional levels: Hideout Base, Zeronite Mine, Super Glue Manufacturer, Defense post, Attack-o-Bot Factory, Fighting Bot Improvement Unit, Defense-o-Bot Factory, Lab of Infinite Knowledge, Workshop.
• The maximum level of the Robot Warehouse has been increased to 20.
• The maximum level of the Private Fight Club has been increased to 20.
• The maximum level of the Gym has been increased to 25.

notes.title: Patch notes 2019-04-30
notes.notes:
The following changes were deployed today (2019-04-30):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New Features
Training 2.0
• The Training system has been completely overhauled.
• For every attribute, there is a workout session to choose from available. Workout session have randomly chosen time limits, costs and rewards.
• During every workout session, up to three Workout Goals can be reached. Reaching a Workout Goal will grant you rewards. To reach Workout Goals, you have to collect Fitness Points.
• You collect Fitness Points through completing offered Fitness Exercises.
• Three different types of Fitness Exercises are available: Fight, Skill and Standard Fitness Exercises. Starting a Fitness Exercise requires Training Energy.
• Training Energy always counts for the current workout session. If you spent Training Energy, it refills automatically over time.

 

General
• As a part of the training system overhaul, Training Units have been renamed to Motivation Units
• Team Time Boosters now reduce the amount of Fitness Points requires to reach Workout Goals within workout sessions. As before, the boosters will also reduce mission times.
• 4 new options for Outfits have been added and the maximum number of Outfits has been increased by 4.
• The option to skip fight animations in Fight Fitness Exercises has been added to the options.
• A new heroic deed for reaching all three Workout Goals within a workout session has been added.

 

Maintenance
General
• The item comparison (green arrow) now disregards modification slots if there are modification slots on both items.
• In the preview for Outfits the set bonus of missiles has not been factored in. This issue has been fixed.
• HTML version: The input line for the team chat has been offset sometimes. This issue has been fixed.
• Several smaller issues have been fixed.
• We’re aware that some teams are abusing/exploiting the team attacks to hold on to team trophies. Actions to prevent this will be applied soon and penalties will be applied to the teams as we see fit.

 

Best,
Your Hero Zero team
